points.text: The answer says that open_bin sets a bin's starting count without writing any movement line, so replaying the movements from an empty book does not arrive at today's counts.
The answer says that set_right rewrites a bin's count without writing any movement line, so working backwards from today's counts goes wrong across any correction.
The answer says that past days from before the change it recommends stay unanswerable, because the book never recorded what answering for them would need.
The answer weighs deriving a past day's holdings from movement lines against keeping a separate record of day-end counts, naming at least one cost of each.
The answer commits to exactly one option as its recommendation and argues for it against at least one other option it considered.

disqualifiers.text: The answer claims that the movement lines already in the book are enough, by themselves, to reconstruct what any bin held at the close of any past day.
